description: This bar chart illustrates the F1 score for different models across several datasets. The horizontal axis, labeled “Dataset,” lists the categories SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “F1 Score (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals.  There are three sets of bars for each dataset, representing the models MADLLM, MADLLM w/o prompt pool, and MADLLM w/o feature embedding, colored green, blue, and purple respectively. For the SMD dataset, the MADLLM bar is approximately 94, the MADLLM w/o prompt pool bar is approximately 88, and the MADLLM w/o feature embedding bar is approximately 84.  Across all datasets, the MADLLM bars are generally the tallest, followed by the MADLLM w/o prompt pool bars, and then the MADLLM w/o feature embedding bars, which are consistently the shortest. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each dataset, and are not sorted by any apparent order. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
